meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Adaptyv Foundry API 帮你操作云实验室：查靶点、估算费用、创建并提交蛋白实验（如结合筛选、热稳定性），之后再取回实验结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白结合实验等关键词，或要求提交蛋白序列做实验表征，或代码 import adaptyv 或 FoundryClient 时接管。

say.text: 帮我查一下 EGFR 靶点，并估算这个筛选实验的费用
say.note: 会列出靶点并返回费用预估

say.text: 用 BLI 方法提交这批结合筛选实验，每个序列 3 个重复
say.note: 会创建实验并提交审核
返回该实验 ID 对应的结果

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Adaptyv Foundry API and Python SDK to run protein experiments in a cloud lab: browse targets, estimate cost, create and submit experiments (binding, thermostability, etc.), and retrieve results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding or BLI/SPR assays, or ask to submit protein sequences for characterization, or when code imports adaptyv or FoundryClient.

say_en.text: Find EGFR targets and estimate the cost of this screening experiment
say_en.note: Lists targets and returns a cost estimate

say_en.text: Submit these binding screens with BLI, 3 replicates per sequence
Fetch the results for this experiment
say_en.note: Returns results for the experiment ID
